entries.11991384007009e4: This business collects and analyzes big data on purchasing from EC malls and the internet as a whole, sets keywords, prices and other terms likely to sell well for products proposed by manufacturers and wholesalers, and sells them on its own group EC sites. Under the trade name “Rikomen-dō”, it operates stores by genre; as of October 31, 2025, there were 87 stores in total on a consolidated basis, and the number of products handled was 2,490,000. Mainly using a drop-shipping method that holds no inventory, it also launched a platform business connecting its own EC sites (USP business) in April 2024. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥13,272 million.

entries.92e1736b41755c9f: This business plans and develops products jointly, mainly with manufacturers, using product data obtained through the EC marketing business. In addition to joint product development based on analysis of best-selling data, it manages production through direct partnerships with overseas subsidiary factories in China, Vietnam and Laos, and also provides information and products to physical stores. It is carried out by the company and subsidiaries such as Qingdao Shintanbo Boeki Co., Ltd. and Genepa Vietnam Co.,Ltd. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥3,213 million.
